lines.text: The LORD sends Jeremiah to the potter's house, where the potter reshapes a flawed vessel into another vessel.
The LORD says Israel is like clay in His hand, and He will relent if a warned nation turns.
The LORD tells Judah and the residents of Samaria to turn from evil, and says they will call it hopeless.
His people forgot the LORD and burn incense to idols, so He will scatter them like the west wind.
Some people plan to denounce Jeremiah, and he asks the LORD whether good should be repaid with evil.
